modelIdentification.name: pyjevsim-sync-points
modelIdentification.description: Reference FOM for the canonical HLA bootstrap pattern: all federates rendezvous at named sync labels (start_simulation, end_simulation) then run an exchange in between. One trivial interaction class (Tick) so the federates have a wire-visible heartbeat during the running phase; the pedagogical focus is on the rendezvous semantics, not the payload.

interactionClass.name: Tick
interactionClass.semantics: Heartbeat sent by each federate during the running phase between start_simulation and end_simulation sync points. Carries the federate's own tick counter so the runner can verify that exactly the expected number of cycles ran between rendezvous points.
